name: nasawa-e-library
description: Nasawa E-Library backend migrated to Vercel + Supabase

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const vm = require('node:vm'); for (const file of ['api/index.js', 'server.js', 'supabaseClient.js', 'SCRIPT.JS', 'BOOK-CATALOG.JS']) new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'), { filename: file }); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('vercel.json', 'utf8'));"
